suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as anatomic compression complication. Require documented degenerative lumbar spinal stenosis and separately diagnosed cauda equina syndrome with correlating compressive/anatomic evidence. PMID 36401862 specifically studied an elderly surgical cohort (>60 years); do not use it to estimate general incidence or generalize its population findings beyond that setting. Radiculopathy, neurogenic claudication, bowel/bladder symptoms, or stenosis on imaging alone do not establish CES. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
